safety_statement: AI matches authorised public tasks, spaces, times and resources only. It does not match, recommend, score or infer people or personal relationships.

admission_gates.name: legal_ownership_task_authorisation
admission_gates.hard_stop: No written authority or ownership/access conflict.

admission_gates.name: venue_safety_access_capacity
admission_gates.hard_stop: Any egress, fire, accessibility, crowd or equipment path fails.

admission_gates.name: data_content_rights_deletion
admission_gates.hard_stop: Uncleared source, excessive field, missing deletion or prohibited personal inference.

admission_gates.name: host_non_ai_fallback_stop_recovery
admission_gates.hard_stop: No human host, non-AI equivalent, emergency stop or restoration procedure.

admission_gates.name: public_benefit_independent_review_handover
admission_gates.hard_stop: No public output, complaint route, review date or adopt/revise/retire decision.

contracts.minimum_output: Access/non-AI baseline, task completion record, deletion log, complaint closeout and public retrospective.
contracts.stop: Any gate blocked; no named A/R; offline equivalent failure; material safety, privacy or exclusion incident.
contracts.handover: Return space, delete expiring data, publish decision and unresolved-issue list.

contracts.synthetic_input: Fixed, versioned public/synthetic fixture; no production connection
contracts.minimum_output: Field-level evidence JSON, model/tool version, human override, hard-stop and rollback receipt.
contracts.stop: Sandbox breach, uncontrolled device behaviour, ungrounded critical answer, unsafe route or rollback failure.
contracts.handover: Restore site, archive fixture/version and record adopt/revise/retire without claiming field performance.

contracts.pilot: Dazhongsi Common City single-event first use
contracts.synthetic_input: Event timetable and synthetic capacity/access constraints only
contracts.minimum_output: Arrival/exit audit, public feedback, restoration receipt and rights-cleared cultural content register.
contracts.stop: No verified station-to-site path, no safe exit, heritage/noise impact, or commercial display displaces public feedback.
contracts.handover: Strike reversible components, restore site and publish the event-level decision.
